_doc: IV.POS.4 part B (solo bandit dispatch). 1 job, 1 node. bandit-16 N=250. Recommended node: --nodes flare (Tier S EPYC 9354) OR --nodes algofi (Tier A EPYC 7543). Expected wall ~14-16 min on EPYC. Sized so post-pilot main loop has 220 iterations (N_pilot=30 for N=250), the minimum for the DiscountedUCBScheduler to produce meaningful arm statistics. Anti-pattern §12.35 reminder: bandit requires N >= 100 (recommended) for the scheduler to advance past t=0. N=250 here is well above that floor. To run the other two strategies (uniform + zoned), see pos_validation_v2_pair.json (separate dispatch).
name: pos_validation_v2_solo
